senses.gloss: m. (גבל) a lump of dough taken out for forming cakes &c., a roll of dough. Y. Ḥall. II, beg. 59ᵃ חלה כמין ג׳ the priest’s gift must be, in shape and substance, like a roll.—Pl. גַּבְלוּלִין.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>משתיעשה ג׳ ג׳</he> from the time that the dough is divided into lumps.
